title: raw baseline: the engine with its heads removed — the honest floor
intro: Press play to walk the same recorded turn through the bare engine: it abstains, and the abstain plays a labelled random spot.

walk.title: The same sentence
walk.text: The same recorded opening turn, sent to the engine with every fitted head removed. Only the corpus remains: nearest-neighbour lookup over what it has literally seen before.

in.label: the same recorded opening turn
in.from: recorded from the raw baseline lane, seed 607, 2026-09-25, arena/demo_oracle.json _meta.sources.tetris_raw · scripts/record_demo_walks.mjs · the opening turn (turn 0)

walk.title: Corpus engine
walk.text: With no heads, the engine can only compare the sentence against its corpus. The spot sentences of a real game are almost all new — so this branch is the one the recorded raw game took, five hundred and fifteen times in a row.

walk.title: In corpus → play the highest
walk.text: When a sentence lands close to something the corpus holds, the engine answers like laya would and the highest-probability neighbour wins. In the whole recorded raw game this path never fired — that honesty is what makes it the floor.

walk.title: Off corpus → abstain, play random
walk.text: Every outcome comes back null — the engine abstains rather than guess. The abstain plays a random legal spot from a separate seeded stream, labelled as random in the replay so nothing pretends to be a decision.

out.label: every P(clean) null · a recorded random pick
